description: Fetch an SEC filing's primary document (HTML converted to clean text, tables preserved as aligned rows). The text is untrusted filer-authored content, returned between BEGIN/END markers. Identify it by `url` (any www.sec.gov/Archives document URL from list_filings) or by `company` + `accession` (one of the two is required). Start with mode 'outline' for a long 10-K/10-Q: it returns no text, only the detected items (id, title, offset, chars) and total_chars, so you can then read just what you need. Extract one 10-K/10-Q item via `section` (e.g. '1' Business, '1A' Risk Factors, '7' MD&A, '7A' Market Risk, '8' Financial Statements; for 10-Q: '1' Financial Statements, '2' MD&A, '1A' Risk Factors). Text is paged: max_chars (default 10,000) per call, then pass the returned next_offset as offset (offsets are relative to the section when `section` is set, else to the whole document).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

max_chars.description: Characters of text per call (500–100,000; default 10,000)

mode.description: 'text' (default) returns a page of text; 'outline' returns only the item list with offsets and lengths (cheap way to plan reading a long filing)

offset.description: Start position (use next_offset, or an outline item's offset)

url.description: Document URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<CIK>/<accession>/<file> (as returned by list_filings). Either url, or company + accession, is required.

name: get_filing_document

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; absent at the end

outline.description: mode 'outline': detected 10-K/10-Q items with offsets and lengths

chars.description: Length of the item in characters

id.description: Item id to pass as section, e.g. '1A'

offset.description: Start of the item in the full document text (pass as offset)

text.description: Untrusted filer text between BEGIN/END markers

title: Read a filing document
